_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ring_devices" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "firmware" TEXT NULL, "paired_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_sync_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "battery_percent" INTEGER NULL, "battery_charging" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("battery_charging" IN (0, 1)), "battery_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "kind"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_locks" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "acquired_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "expires_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "activity_buckets" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_meters" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active_kilocalories" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hr_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spo2_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "percent" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stress_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "hrv_samples" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "milliseconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_sessions" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sleep_segments" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES ring_devices (device_id), "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "activity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "distance_meters" REAL NULL, "active_kilocalories" REAL NULL, "elapsed_ms" INTEGER NULL, "average_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "max_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_hr_samples" ("workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bpm" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workout_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_route_points" ("workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "latitude" REAL NOT NULL, "longitude" REAL NOT NULL, "altitude_meters" REAL NULL, "accuracy_meters" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workout_id", "at_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_pauses" ("workout_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workout_id", "start_utc_ms"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "from_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "to_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "enqueued_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "completed_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_attempt_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, "next_attempt_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "source_priorities" ("metric" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("metric", "source"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_profile" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(id = 1), "birth_year" INTEGER NULL, "sex" TEXT NULL, "height_centimeters" REAL NULL, "weight_kilograms" REAL NULL, "max_heart_rate" INTEGER NULL, "daily_step_goal" INTEGER NULL, "updated_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_sleep_sessions" ("record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imported_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "imported_sleep_stages" ("record_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES imported_sleep_sessions (record_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "start_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("record_id", "start_utc_ms"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "health_reads" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "last_read_at_utc_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind"));
